rows: A forgotten or inconvenient {obligation} tied to {past_event} is called in by {initiating_actor}.
The claimant presents proof or witnesses that make dismissal costly.
What is lost by honoring, refusing or renegotiating the obligation?
The obligation conflicts with a newer duty.
Was the original promise understood the same way by everyone?
Who benefits from enforcing it now?
A Debt You Did Not Make
The characters or their allies inherit an {obligation} created by {past_event}.
A creditor, institution or consequence arrives before anyone has agreed what inheritance means.
What can legitimately be inherited: cost, responsibility, guilt or opportunity?
A second party asserts a conflicting claim on the same legacy.
Can responsibility be separated from benefit?
Someone once helped an {affected_actor}, and now repayment is requested in an unexpected form.
The requested help is legal or reasonable on its face but creates difficult secondary consequences.
Whose trust or position changes if the favor is repaid?
The requester reveals that time is shorter than expected.
What would count as fair repayment?
The Contract Means More Than It Said
An {obligation} contains a clause, tradition or interpretation that changes what someone owes.
An {authority_actor} recognizes the interpretation as plausible enough to enforce.
What becomes binding if the interpretation stands?
A counter-interpretation appears with its own precedent.
An {affected_actor} becomes the responsibility of someone who did not expect or want the role.
A threat, deadline or social expectation makes passive guardianship impossible.
What does safety cost the protected person or guardian?
The protected person pursues a goal that conflicts with protection.
What autonomy does the protected person retain?
A community connected to {location} expects help fulfilling an {obligation} that has always been shared.
The expected participants are missing, divided or unable to carry their normal share.
What happens to belonging or trust if the duty is neglected?
Fulfilling the duty reveals a larger unresolved problem.
Who decides what counts as a fair contribution?
Why can the normal participants not act?
Two Oaths Cannot Both Be Simple
Two legitimate {obligation} commitments now point in incompatible directions.
Both parties invoke the commitments before there is time for an easy compromise.
What identity or relationship is threatened by choosing either priority?
A third option becomes possible but carries a different cost.
Were the commitments ever meant to conflict?
Who can release or reinterpret an oath?
Work Was Done; Payment Was Not
An {initiating_actor} claims a promised {resource} or service was never properly paid.
The claim is credible, but payment now harms someone who was not part of the original bargain.
Who bears the cost of correcting an old imbalance?
Evidence suggests the original payer believed the account settled.
Was payment withheld, lost, misdirected or redefined?
What would repair look like now?
A group previously saved or aided now asks for help with a problem tied to {location}.
Their request is urgent but their preferred approach would create new risks.
What does refusing mean for the relationship built by the earlier aid?
The group splits over what kind of help they actually want.
What do they believe is owed?
Can aid be given without endorsing their plan?
The Duty Nobody Can Publicly Explain
An {obligation} must be fulfilled while its reason or sponsor remains concealed.
A public explanation becomes necessary before the secret can safely be revealed.
What happens if the duty is exposed without context?
Someone correctly notices the pattern but draws the wrong conclusion.
Who is authorized to know the reason?
What part of the duty can be explained honestly?
An {affected_actor} who was expected at {location} fails to appear and leaves no clear explanation.
A small {evidence} suggests the absence is not a simple delay.
What changes if the person remains missing through the next important event?
Another person reports a contradictory last sighting.
Who noticed the absence first and why?
The Missing Thing Matters for More Than Its Price
A {target} disappears from a place where its absence creates obligations, suspicion or danger.
Evidence points toward several plausible motives rather than one obvious thief.
What function, relationship or secret depended on the object being present?
Someone offers to return it under unexpected conditions.
Was it stolen, borrowed, relocated or removed for protection?
A known route to {location} can no longer be found, reached or used in the expected way.
Someone arrives from the supposedly unreachable side with incomplete information.
Who or what is cut off by the lost route?
Alternative routes carry costs or enter contested territory.
Did the route move, close, become hidden or cease to exist?
An {affected_actor} has lost a memory connected to {past_event}, but something important still depends on it.
A familiar cue produces a fragment that raises more questions than it answers.
What decision cannot be made safely without the missing memory?
A second person remembers the event differently.
Was the memory lost naturally, deliberately or protectively?
What remains emotionally true even if facts are unclear?
A trusted reserve of {resource} is found depleted earlier than expected.
Records, witnesses or physical signs disagree about where it went.
Who suffers first if the resource cannot be replaced?
A remaining supply appears at a politically or morally costly source.
Was the reserve consumed, stolen, spoiled, redirected or miscounted?
A {location} that should be occupied is suddenly abandoned without a clear public explanation.
Signs show that departure was organized in some ways and chaotic in others.
What was left behind that should have mattered to the occupants?
Evidence suggests some people never left.
What were they afraid of or trying to protect?
A reliable {initiating_actor} stops responding after sending one ambiguous message.
A third party claims the silence is normal or intentional.
What plan depended on the contact's next message?
Someone begins acting on instructions allegedly sent by the silent contact.
Is the silence protective, coerced or accidental?
Who can verify the last message?
A Name Is Missing From the Record
A person, place or event tied to {past_event} has been removed from records that should preserve it.
One overlooked {evidence} still carries the missing reference.
What rights or truths disappear when the name disappears?
A powerful actor insists the omission is legitimate.
Who had the ability to alter the record?
Was the erasure punishment, protection or concealment?
The Expected Future Is No Longer Available
A planned opportunity involving {target} or {location} abruptly becomes impossible.
Someone offers a different path that was previously unacceptable or invisible.
What did people build their expectations around?
The alternative path demands a new alliance or sacrifice.
Is the original future truly gone?
Something Returned Without What It Carried
A vessel, vehicle, body or container returns from {location} without the {target} it was expected to carry.
Physical evidence shows the loss happened after departure but before return.
What danger follows if the missing target is loose, stranded or taken?
The returned carrier begins showing a new unexplained property.
Who or what could access the carrier?
